entries.note: Label 运单创建. The waybill is in the system; the parcel has not reached the warehouse yet.
Label 包裹入库. The warehouse in Aurora takes the parcel in.
Label 仓库扣款. The warehouse charges the shipping fee seconds after taking the parcel in; the parcel does not move.
Label 组批次. The parcel joins the batch for a flight to China.

entries.wording: 包裹已出库 送往机场
entries.english: Left the warehouse for the airport

entries.note: Label 飞行中: on the flight to China.
Label 航班到达. The flight lands in China; customs comes next.
Label 准备清关. The carrier's remark goes on to give a customer service agent's name and mobile, which the adapter leaves out.

entries.wording: 清关完成，进入国内物流环节，请您耐心等待派送
entries.english: Customs cleared, handed to delivery in China, please wait for delivery
entries.note: Label 清关完成. Customs released the parcel.

entries.wording: 国内开始派送,快递公司:顺丰速运,单号:…
entries.english: Delivery in China started, courier SF Express, number …
entries.note: Label 国内配送. The parcel is handed to the courier in China under the number the remark gives.
Label 国内签收. The courier in China delivered the parcel.
